name: Cassava-leaf stir-fry
summary: Young cassava leaves and male papaya flowers stir-fried with steamed scad in pork fat over a very low flame. The plate is bitter, fatty, and hot from xiêm chili.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 names lá mì xào cá hấp as an Êđê rainy-season plate.
howToEat: The leaves stay moist and the flowers stay crisp. It is a rainy-season plate, made when the cassava tops rise.
where: Đường sách cà phê, at a highland tasting.
seoTitle: La mi xao — cassava leaves and steamed scad
seoDescription: Cassava leaves and papaya flowers stir-fried with steamed scad in pork fat: bitter, fatty, and hot.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls the plate bitter from the leaves and the flowers, fatty from the pork fat and the fish, and hot from xiêm chili.
